The '''New Muckworks''' was a chemical processing facility built on<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] that was designed to filter any valuable compounds out of the chemicals and liquid pollutants in the [[Water/Legends|waters]] of the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. Whatever chemicals remained after the processing were returned back to the swamp water.<ref name="Codex" />

Built several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> to replace the [[Old Muckworks|Jiguuna Muckworks]], the New Muckworks were constructed to the west of the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]], but a critical failure occurred shortly after the facility went online, crippling the New Muckworks. As a result, the Jiguuna Muckworks, which had become known as the "Old Muckworks," returned to active use.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The New Muckworks was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Old Muckworks in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
